clientsIntro: Clients are only for billing. They never change your time entries.
archivedHint: Hidden from the project picker. Their projects and history stay as they are.
rateHintDefault: Empty means this project bills at the default {rate} {currency} an hour. A task can still override it.
rateHintNone: Empty means this project has no rate of its own, and falls back to the default in Settings → Timer.
budgetHint: A limit for this project. Progress shows in the project header, and you get a notice at 80% and at 100%.
budgetLimitError: {label} must be a number above 0 and up to {max}.
